checks.title: MySQL major version is 8.0 or newer
checks.rationale: MySQL 5.7 reached EOL October 2023; only 8.0+ receives upstream security fixes.
checks.remediation: Upgrade to MySQL 8.0 LTS (or MySQL 8.4 LTS).

checks.title: TLS is enabled for client connections
checks.rationale: Without TLS, credentials and result sets traverse the network in cleartext.
checks.remediation: Configure ssl-cert, ssl-key, ssl-ca and restart mysqld.

checks.title: Default authentication plugin is caching_sha2_password
checks.rationale: caching_sha2_password supports channel binding and stronger hashing than legacy mysql_native_password.
checks.remediation: Set default_authentication_plugin=caching_sha2_password in my.cnf and rotate user passwords with ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED WITH caching_sha2_password.

checks.title: local_infile is disabled
checks.rationale: local_infile=ON allows attackers who control a client to read arbitrary local files.

checks.title: secure_file_priv is set to a fixed directory (not empty)
checks.rationale: Empty secure_file_priv allows SELECT INTO OUTFILE / LOAD DATA INFILE anywhere on disk.

checks.title: skip_symbolic_links is enabled
checks.rationale: Symbolic links could be abused to escape the data directory.

checks.title: General query log is OFF in production
checks.rationale: general_log captures all statements including passwords; off in production.

checks.title: No accounts have an empty password
checks.command: mysql -N -B -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE authentication_string='' AND plugin NOT IN ('auth_socket','mysql_no_login');" 2>/dev/null
checks.rationale: Any account with no password is a trivial breach vector.
checks.remediation: ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY '<password>' for each, or DROP USER if unused.

checks.title: Manual: review users with global SUPER / SYSTEM_USER / SET_USER_ID privileges
checks.audit: Query 'SELECT * FROM information_schema.user_privileges WHERE privilege_type IN ("SUPER","SYSTEM_USER","SET_USER_ID");'. Confirm only DBA accounts hold these.
checks.rationale: Holders of SUPER-level privileges can bypass most security controls.
checks.remediation: REVOKE excess SUPER-level privileges; create scoped roles for application accounts.

checks.title: Manual: confirm backup encryption and retention policy
checks.audit: Confirm mysqldump / mysqlpump / mysqlbackup output is encrypted (e.g., gpg or filesystem encryption) and stored per retention policy.
checks.rationale: Cleartext backups expose all data if storage is breached.
checks.remediation: Encrypt backups (gpg / native MySQL Enterprise Backup encryption) and verify restore drills.
